title: Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class model
summary: Meta launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full for agentic tasks, priced near Claude Opus 5.5 but trailing it on benchmarks.
reason: New frontier entrant from a major lab.

title: China projected to spend $3.9T on grid to power AI data centers
summary: BloombergNEF projects China will spend $3.9T through 2049 moving inland wind and solar power to coastal AI data centers; State Grid plans ~$574B over five years.
reason: Long-horizon national compute-energy buildout; projection rather than event.

title: Report: only 3.6% of 857 Chinese AI model releases published safety evaluations
summary: A SemiAnalysis study reported by the FT found Chinese developers published safety tests for just 3.6% of 857 model releases, arguing Beijing will not 'pace the frontier'.
reason: Evidence of weak safety-eval practice in China; analysis rather than event.

title: AI tool lets police pinpoint a home from a single interior photo
summary: Graylark's Raven (formerly GeoSpy) lets police upload one interior photo and identify the specific house or rental by matching public Airbnb, Zillow and Vrbo listings; LAPD and Miami-Dade are users.
reason: New AI police surveillance capability in use by large departments.
